-Bianca"},{"spec_id":"spec_0672","text":"Ticketing vendor demo (AGAIN, since last tme nobody showed) - decide yes/no on teh day"},{"spec_id":"spec_0673","text":"FW: Szabo sync 15min - please come, client is asking us decision before tomorrow, I am worry."},{"spec_id":"spec_0674","text":"Subject: grab 30 min next week?

Hey Victor,

Can we find 30 minutes for a 1:1 sometime next week? Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon works best for me, so just throw something on my calendar here: [link]

No big agenda, just want to catch up on a few things, and maybe touch on the Delacroix contract if there's time.

Unrelated, but heads up that the lot behind the Main St location is being repaved Monday through Wednesday, so park on the street or in the garage. Validation details are here: [link]

Also, Wen's birthday is Thursday. Ximena is collecting for a cake, so ping her if you want in. And lunch on Friday is on the group, with Kenji ordering from the usual place.

Thanks man!
Vikram"},{"spec_id":"spec_0675","text":"PREP for Lattice 2.0 Council Briefing: finalize agenda (Lucia), confirm presenters + slide owners (Andre Kowalczyk: budget slides, Jada Mbatha: timeline, Jonas Zapata: IT risks), decide who handles public comment Qs (Bianca Petrakis?), review talking points draft v3 (Quinn Petrakis), logistics/AV check (Hector Grummond), dry-run order of speakers, discuss what we say if they ask about the delay — 60 min, all 8, sorry for the long title, just want to make sure nothing gets missed this time | Andre: my slides are basically done, can I just send them? | Jada: timeline only needs 5 min of review, fine to join for that part | Hector: AV is already booked, nothing to discuss on my end, I'll confirm via email | Quinn: v3 is in the shared folder, comments welcome there before we meet | Jonas: risk section is the one thing I'd really like to talk through as a group, especially the delay question | Bianca: happy to take public comment, no need to meet on that"}]}
